ADD ONE complete layer of matching unit blocks at the BASE, below the current bottom layer, extending the height by exactly one unit. Do not subdivide an existing layer into two thin half-rows: the added layer is equal in height to every other unit block. Preserve ten columns along each horizontal edge, hence a ten-by-ten-by-ten regular physical assembly. Align the new bottom layer's joints with the existing columns and preserve the clean unlettered background. No detached cubes, labels or arrows.

entries.latestReviewBasis: 원본·320px에서 큰 구조의 가로·세로·깊이 각10칸과 중앙5+5 경계를 직접 대조했다. 격자 수량은 개선됐다. 다만 CSS2배 하단 확대에서 분리된 비교 큐브의 수직 모서리는 원본 약71px이고 큰 구조의 가까운 단위 셀은 약55px로, 같은 지면/평행 투영의 한 단위로 제안한 크기와 맞지 않는다. 실제 물리적 크기나 카메라 거리를 추정하지 않고 동일 단위 비교의 검증 미달로 보류한다. 다음에는 큰 구조를 보존하고 비교 큐브 크기·방향을 맞춘다.

entries.scenePrompt: Keep the LARGE BLUE TEN-BY-TEN-BY-TEN assembly completely unchanged, including every grid line and all three axes. Only correct the detached SMALL BLUE CUBE at the lower right. It is visibly too large. Reduce that one cube uniformly to about 78 percent of its present size. Its projected vertical edge should be about55px in this1086px-wide target, matching the large assembly's nearest small cell, rather than its current roughly71px. Match the small cube's face orientation and edge slopes to a unit cell at the large cube's closest lower corner, with front projected width about50px and right projected width about35px. Place its base on the same ground level as that nearest corner, a small distance to the right, so the equal physical unit relation is directly comparable. Preserve its solid blue surfaces and natural grounding shadow. Do not add writing or any measuring annotation. The textbook unit convention remains one million per small unit; the image depicts the thousand-unit ratio, not that convention in text.

entries.scenePrompt: A local additive correction to the existing bee: KEEP ALL FOUR CURRENT LEGS intact, including their current bases, segments and ends. Add TWO NEW jointed FRONT LEGS, one left and one right, emerging from distinct points on the front of the THORAX immediately below the head. Show this new pair in the foreground against the upper thorax: their elbow bends extend to each side and their clawed tips reach forward toward the viewer in separate visible spaces between the existing outward upper legs and the existing long downward legs. The new legs must not originate in the head, mouth, abdomen or wing. All six legs must remain continuously connected and individually traceable, with no overlap hiding a limb's base or end. This adds one actual pair to the four existing legs; merely turning the existing legs does not correct the defect. Preserve all FOUR wings, both antennae, abdomen, bubble, colors and background. No labels, arrows, digits or extra symbols.
